description: Lifecycle proof for Studio's shared email inbox (Mailpit): it starts with the first site, is shared, stops with the last site, recovers from a crash, moves off a taken port, and lets sites start when it can't be downloaded, with email landing at each step. Runs the built Studio CLI in an isolated config and daemon. Set HOMEBOY_RIG_COMPONENT_PATH__STUDIO_SITE_EMAIL__STUDIO to the built Studio checkout under test.

check.label: Studio CLI includes the Mailpit wrapper
